name: Victory Road 2F Central Caverns
summary: Ascend to 2F and traverse winding ridges lined with seasoned trainers. Note for vanilla players: Moltres does NOT spawn on this floor in Infinite Fusion; the Legendary Fire Bird is situated on Mt. Ember in the Sevii Islands (Act 3). Collect valuable battle TMs and prepare for the 3F drop puzzle.

items.name: TM82 Dragon Tail
items.method: Lying along the central rocky pathway

items.name: TM74 Gyro Ball
items.method: Found in the far northeastern corner behind a maze of rocks

items.name: Max Potion
items.method: Located in the southeast corner near the climbing ledges

items.name: Full Restore
items.method: Tucked away in the northeast alcove past the trainer line

items.name: Revive
items.method: Adjacent to the pressure plate awaiting a dropped boulder from 3F
